NIL is a major deal and if you’re not being honest about how that impacts recruiting you’re being disingenuous. On top of the strict academic requirements impacting who we can get in the transfer portal the program is being handicapped in this current landscape of college athletics. ️ Show less Read more Like 5 Dislike Reply @johnl6537 10 months ago (edited) I hope Coach Ivey can start running a team, half court offense sometimes. Good teams are able to contain a single player that drives every time. Good team players don't want to work and watch bad shot selection when they are open. Season tickets are purchased. I hope to see a team that can stay healthy and be more than 1 player. ND has had success putting team above player. Show less Read more Like 2 Dislike Reply @ndbutch 10 months ago (edited) Kate Koval didn't leave because she wasn't being developed. That was the most palpable excuse or reason. Carol Owen's did fine with the likes of Ruth Riley, Natalie Achonwa, Jessica Sheppard, Dev Peter's and Brianna Turner, etc. What's going on is something Irish fans don't want to admit even though portal exits and what's coming back in return are screaming the facts. The picture of a beaming Olivia Miles and Koval at the WNBA game are a gossamer hint. The fact that they signed one recruit in two consecutive classes in the portal age is on Coach Ivey and staff. The fact that the prospect of playing with HH without the buffers Miles, Citron, Westbeld, Watson provided seems to be about as popular as pond scum.....
